escalation._note: Auto-SOS fires only when the trip is overdue (return time + grace), a further auto_sos_minutes_after_overdue has passed, the boat went more than offshore_km out, and the phone has either been silent for signal_silent_minutes or is still reporting from offshore. Adding time ('More time') moves every step back.

_sources: Starting values based on the Beaufort scale and the WMO sea-state table; to be validated with fishers.
